opportunities.title: Junior Scientist Conference Grants

deadlines.raw: 1st day of February, April, June, August, October and December

amount.raw: up to £200, up to £500, up to £750, up to £300

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Scheme (A) open to undergraduate, Master’s and PhD student members and postdoctoral scientists within six years of their PhD viva; Schemes (B) & (C) open to PhD students and postdoctoral scientists within six years of their PhD viva; UK‑based members for non‑UK conferences and non‑UK members for UK conferences.
opportunities.summary: Supports attendance of Genetics Society junior scientist members at genetics‑related conferences (Society meetings, other meetings, or virtual conferences).

opportunities.title: Training Grant
opportunities.eligibility_summary: All members of the Genetics Society who are studying or working in the UK (or attending a UK‑based course). Students must be members; others need at least one year of membership.
opportunities.summary: Grants up to £1,200 to enable members to attend short genetics‑related training courses or collaborative lab visits.

opportunities.title: Heredity Fieldwork Grant
opportunities.eligibility_summary: All members of the Genetics Society studying or working in the UK (or planning UK fieldwork). Students must be members; others need at least one year of membership.
opportunities.summary: Awards up to £2,000 to cover travel, accommodation and related costs for field‑based genetic research projects suitable for publication in the journal Heredity.

opportunities.title: One-off Meeting Grant

amount.raw: up to several thousand pounds (major sponsorship levels between £1,000 and £2,000)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Members may apply at any time; applications should be submitted at least three months before the event and include a Carer’s Award where appropriate.
opportunities.summary: Sponsorship for genetics‑themed meetings not organised directly by the Society, covering meeting costs and optionally a Carer’s Award.

opportunities.title: Public Engagement Grant
opportunities.summary: Grants up to £1,000 to support public engagement activities related to genetics, covering travel and materials costs (UK‑based travel only).

opportunities.title: Special Interest Group Funding
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Groups applying to become a new Special Interest Group; applications should be submitted at least three months before the first meeting and include a funding proposal.
opportunities.summary: Sponsorship of research meetings on particular themes, providing up to £2,000 per year for regular series of meetings.
